neighbours.label: ' much' / ' many' right after the intensifier 'so'
fire: There were so many people at the market this morning.
Thank you so much for coming to the party.
She has so many books that her shelves are bending.
The city has changed so much since I was a child.
We have so much work left before the deadline.
Why are there so many cars on this road today?
He talks so much that nobody else can speak.
I learned so many new words on the trip.
quiet: There were too many people at the market this morning.
Thank you very much for coming to the party.
She has a lot of books and her shelves are bending.
The city has changed a great deal since I was a child.
We have too much work left before the deadline.
Why are there more cars on this road today?
He talks constantly and nobody else can speak.
I learned how many new words there were on the trip.
